$provenance: Generated by Phase 2.4b of the desktop->web transition from the Qt sources named in 'generated_from', before sub-step 2.5 deleted them. Regenerate only by editing this file: the sources no longer exist. Every literal string was verified against the AST of the file it cites at extraction time.

recommendation_field_order.CORRECTNESS_CRITICAL: Maps a chart type to the ORDER in which ChartSuggestion.columns fill that chart's fields. Do NOT zip ChartSuggestion.columns positionally against ChartRegistration.required_fields: for Line, recommend_charts returns [date_column, numeric_column] (x then y) while LineChart.build / required_fields=('y_column',) puts y first, so a positional zip SILENTLY SWAPS Line's x and y on every recommendation-driven build. 'heatmap' has no column fields and is deliberately absent from this table -- not an oversight.

report_section_labels.rule: Only 8 of the 10 pipeline stages can be report sections. REPORT and REPRODUCE are deliberately absent -- you cannot put 'Report' in a report. The labels mirror uadas_core/services/report_service.py's _STAGE_DISPLAY_NAMES; the 8-of-10 subsetting is the part recorded only here.

explanation_fields.rule: Every field is a collapsible section whose title stays visible and announced while collapsed. Per-ExpertiseLevel default-expanded sets (EXPLANATION_DEFAULT_EXPANDED) are NOT here -- they are restated in full in plans/ui-overhaul-pioneering-adaptive-workbench.md.

forecaster_menu.default_first: Automatic Model Competition is listed first as the recommended default for a user who has not already decided which method to use.
